_comment: Every design reads the same site drops, documents and site answers. Ablations switch off one safeguard each.

naive.name: As-is
naive.label: Read the headers as sent: SUV from the tags as they are, slices in instance order, every send counted, patients keyed by site ID, no calibration check, no queries to sites, every extracted fact kept, headers and text passed on

pipeline.name: Pipeline
pipeline.label: Plausibility rules that refuse and query, decay reference respected, slices by position with gap check, duplicates removed, patients linked across sites, liver-reference calibration check, code-checked facts and induced terms, allowlist de-identification

no_unit_rules.name: No unit rules
no_unit_rules.label: Weight and dose used as sent

no_decay_reference.name: No decay reference
no_decay_reference.label: Dose always decayed to scan start, whatever the image's DecayCorrection says

no_timing_rule.name: No timing rule
no_timing_rule.label: Uptake time used as computed, even when negative

no_slice_rules.name: No slice rules
no_slice_rules.label: Slices in instance-number order, no gap check

no_dedupe.name: No de-duplication
no_dedupe.label: A re-sent series counts as another scan

no_linkage.name: No linkage
no_linkage.label: Patients keyed by site and site ID, so a referral is two people

no_term_checks.name: No fact checks
no_term_checks.label: Every fact the reader proposes is kept; new terms enter on first sight

no_deid.name: No de-identification
no_deid.label: Headers and documents passed on as received
